mechanism_narrative: Transit-station footfall leads discretionary retail trips by roughly one to two weeks. TRANSIT has risen monotonically from -64.3 (t-2w) to -61.3 (t-1w) to -59.1 (t-0w), so the next 28-day RETAIL_REC mean exceeds the trailing 28-day mean of -68.6.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved from -64.3 at t-2w to -59.1 at t-0w
regime_hint: steady post-holiday reopening with case counts falling
failure_condition: The next-28-day mean of RETAIL_REC is less than or equal to -68.6 while TRANSIT remains above -60, which rejects the transit-leads-retail channel.

mechanism_narrative: Stay-at-home intensity is the binding constraint on discretionary outings. RESIDENTIAL falling below 18.0 signals that households are reallocating time away from home, which mechanically raises RETAIL_REC over the following two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL weekly mean falls below 18.0 (t-1w = 18.7, t-0w = 17.4)
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL declined from 20.0 at t-2w to 17.4 at t-0w
failure_condition: In weeks where RESIDENTIAL prints below 18.0, RETAIL_REC fails to improve or moves lower, contradicting the time-release mechanism.

mechanism_narrative: The retail rebound is gated by joint recovery of transit and workplace presence: gains only compound when both series improve together. With TRANSIT at -59.1 and WORKPLACES at -53.1 and both improving versus t-1w, the multiplicative channel lifts the next 28-day RETAIL_REC mean above the trailing mean.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both improve week-on-week relative to their t-1w values
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved from -54.6 at t-2w to -53.1 at t-0w
failure_condition: Instances where TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both improve show RETAIL_REC next-28-day mean at or below the trailing mean, which rejects the joint-recovery gate.

mechanism_narrative: Vaccination rollout with indoor-capacity caps still binding shifts trips from essential provisioning toward discretionary browsing. GROCERY_PHARM normalising from -39.4 to -31.4 releases shopping time that reappears in RETAIL_REC over the following four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM recovered from -39.4 at t-2w to -31.4 at t-0w
regime_hint: vaccination rollout with partial reopening and capacity caps (February 2021)
failure_condition: Under the same rollout-and-caps regime, GROCERY_PHARM recovery is accompanied by flat or falling next-28-day RETAIL_REC means.

mechanism_narrative: The t-0w retail reading of -64.6 is inflated by the Presidents' Day holiday week and cold-weather substitution out of parks. As the holiday and weather effects unwind, the forward 28-day mean reverts below the trailing mean of -68.6.
candidate_trigger: PARKS weekly mean below -55.0, indicating cold-weather suppression of outdoor activity
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS remained deeply negative at -58.7 in t-0w
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC next-28-day mean is greater than -68.6 while PARKS stays below -55.0, the holiday/weather reversion account is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous normalisation of grocery runs and park visits marks a broad return of out-of-home routines rather than a single-purpose errand pattern. The joint improvement in GROCERY_PHARM and PARKS drives higher discretionary retail footfall within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM and PARKS both improve versus their t-3w values (both are less negative at t-0w)
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS improved from -63.7 at t-2w to -58.7 at t-0w
regime_hint: partial reopening with voluntary risk avoidance
failure_condition: Weeks with joint GROCERY_PHARM and PARKS improvement that do not precede a higher next-28-day RETAIL_REC mean refute the routine-normalisation mechanism.

mechanism_narrative: A discrete transit threshold marks the point at which trip-chaining resumes at scale. Once the TRANSIT weekly mean crosses above -58.0, discretionary retail follows within one week because errand bundling becomes viable again.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT weekly mean crosses above -58.0 (t-0w = -59.1, one point below the threshold)
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT rose 2.2 points from -61.3 at t-1w to -59.1 at t-0w
failure_condition: TRANSIT crosses above -58.0 but RETAIL_REC over the following week fails to exceed its level in the crossing week.

mechanism_narrative: Time released from home interacts with stagnant workplace presence to redirect activity into leisure and retail outings. RESIDENTIAL falling from 20.0 to 17.4 while WORKPLACES stays near -53 reallocates hours toward RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL declines week-on-week while WORKPLACES is flat or declining week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES moved only 0.8 points from -53.9 at t-1w to -53.1 at t-0w while RESIDENTIAL fell 1.3 points
failure_condition: In weeks where RESIDENTIAL falls and WORKPLACES is flat or lower, the next-28-day RETAIL_REC mean is at or below the trailing mean, rejecting the time-reallocation channel.
